appearances.name: Lackadaisy · Hommage · Rocky Rickaby
appearances.identity: Clothing-only homage to Rocky Rickaby as shown in the official acrylic standee: a blue-teal 1920s long suit coat and matching tailored trousers, golden mustard waistcoat, pale cream shirt, broad dark teal fedora with a bright yellow hatband fitted behind the huge frog eyes. Ribbit's small bright pink bow replaces a necktie; tiny violin-shaped brass lapel pin, brown ankle gaiters above bare green three-toed webbed feet. Preserve Ribbit's smooth lime frog face and thin long limbs, four-finger green hands, wide white eyes, pink round cheeks. No biological cat ears, fur, whiskers, cat tail, human hair or human features. All clothes cleanly tailored to Ribbit. The official standee provides blue/teal and mustard costume colors; the older Jax image only supplies Encore linework and period tailoring. No large handheld violin, no lettering, no standee backdrop.

appearances.name: Lackadaisy · Résident · Coursier du Little Daisy
appearances.identity: Original 1920s neighborhood courier adaptation for Ribbit in the Little Daisy district: a soft brown herringbone flat cap behind the two frog eyes, pale cream shirt with rolled sleeves, olive waistcoat with brass buttons, cropped high-waisted navy trousers and brown suspenders, worn brown leather messenger satchel attached by a diagonal strap, one cream folded envelope tucked into its pocket, dark brown ankle straps above bare webbed toes. Pink bow at collar, lime smooth frog face and uncovered thin green forearms and lower legs, four green fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot. Warm brown/olive/navy palette and period materials from the resident reference. No fur, feline ears, tail, weapons, cigarette, alcohol, human face, words or labels. A single coherent still character.

appearances.name: Lackadaisy · Fusion · Chat des bayous
appearances.identity: An ORIGINAL physical frog-and-cat fusion, not a frog wearing a cat costume. Keep unmistakable Ribbit identity with two enormous protruding white frog eyes with black wedge-cut pupils, round pink cheeks, friendly wide cream frog muzzle and small pink bow. Rebuild the body as a slim moss-green short-furred feline-amphibian with two small triangular cat ears BEHIND the frog eyes, a few neat whiskers, elongated digitigrade frog-cat hind legs, broad three-toed webbed paws, four-fingered pawlike hands, and one long attached curved green striped feline tail fully inside the frame. Green fur and cream belly; do not use Jax's purple skin, long rabbit ears, yellow eyes or rabbit muzzle. Dress this reimagined anatomy in a cream rolled-sleeve 1920s shirt, dark brown pinstriped trousers ending below the knees, dark suspenders, pink bow tie. The silhouette must visibly differ anatomically from standard tall thin Ribbit while retaining frog eyes, pink cheeks, mouth and bow. No floating effects, claws out, body horror or extra limbs.
